title: Hotel Website
description: Resort and hotel template with rooms, gallery, facilities, reviews, and enquiry flows.

blocks.text: Use tempjs hotel to generate a boutique hotel or resort site. The admin portal manages room types, gallery images, facilities, reviews, promo banners, and leads. Demo brand: Lakeside Haven Resort (Lonavala).

items: Room types with slug detail pages and enquiry modals

blocks.text: Besides standard brand and contact flags, hotel init supports tagline, developer/operator name, channel partner, and a nearby landmark line (templeDistance) shown on the contact section.
Real estate templates use --agent-rera instead of --temple-distance. Options are defined per template in templates.json under init.brandFields.

blocks.code:
mkdir lakeside-client && cd lakeside-client
tempjs hotel config

# Non-interactive full setup
tempjs hotel --config --yes \
  --theme theme1 --font modern \
  --name "Lakeside Haven Resort" \
  --short-name "Lakeside Haven" \
  --base-url https://lakesidehaven.com \
  --phone 9876543210 \
  --email reservations@lakesidehaven.com \
  --address "Lonavala, Maharashtra, India" \
  --tagline "Where Nature Meets Refined Comfort" \
  --temple-distance "5 min walk to Lonavala Lake" \
  --db-host localhost --db-name lakeside_db --admin-user admin --admin-password changeme
